context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 85 validated CalendarPage external events visualization: (1) GET /api/users/me/caldav-events?days=90 called on mount alongside /calendar/events. (2) externalDates memo creates Set of dates with external events. (3) hasExternal modifier applies striped background to dates with external events but NO meetings (meeting wins visually). (4) calendar-legend shows both 'Meeting' (green) and 'Externer Termin' (striped) swatches when either meetingDates or externalDates is non-empty. (5) external-events-block renders in day-detail when selectedDayExternal.length > 0, showing 'Externer Kalender (N)' heading. (6) Each external-event-{i} card shows summary, time range (HH:mm-HH:mm or 'ganztägig' for all-day), and location if present. (7) Styling uses striped diagonal pattern background + grey left border (dezent as requested). (8) When no external events on selected day, block is NOT rendered. (9) Regression: Iter 84 CalDAV endpoints (GET/PUT /caldav-config, POST /caldav-sync, GET /meetings/conflicts) all working.
